🐜 Best AI Tools for Pest Control Companies (2026)

For a pest control company, start with Kickserv or Service Fusion for scheduling and invoicing, Rosie or Dialzara for phone answering, and QuickBooks Online or Wave for the books. Kickserv and Service Fusion are the tools in our directory that list pest control. Rosie is built for home-service businesses and includes 250 minutes for $49/mo. Dialzara starts at $29/mo for 60 minutes and lists cleaners. QuickBooks Online Simple Start is $38/mo, and Wave Starter is $0. Prices come from each vendor's own pricing page.

FAQ

What software does a small pest control company need?Three jobs: schedule and invoice work in the field, answer the phone while techs are out, and keep the books. Kickserv and Service Fusion are the tools here that list pest control. Rosie or Dialzara covers calls. QuickBooks Online or Wave handles bookkeeping and invoicing.
How much does pest control business software cost?From our directory (vendor prices checked Oct 16, 2026): Kickserv Start $60/mo for 5 users, Service Fusion Starter $208/mo billed annually ($245 monthly) with unlimited users, Rosie Professional $49/mo for 250 minutes, Dialzara from $29/mo for 60 minutes, QuickBooks Online Simple Start $38/mo (free plan $0 for 1 user and 2 invoices a month), and Wave Starter $0 (Pro $19/mo).
Kickserv or Service Fusion for a pest control company?Both list pest control. Kickserv Start is $60/mo with 5 users, a 30-day free trial and an easy setup of about 1–2 days; it has fewer integrations. Service Fusion Starter is $208/mo billed annually with unlimited users on every plan, and setup takes about 1–3 weeks. The listings cover scheduling, estimates, invoicing and user counts.
Do I need an AI receptionist for a pest control company?If calls come in while techs are on a job, an answering service can take messages, book appointments or transfer urgent calls. Rosie Professional is $49/mo for 250 minutes, built for home-service businesses, with setup in about 10–20 minutes. Dialzara starts at $29/mo for 60 minutes, lists cleaners, transfers urgent calls and has no contract. Its entry plan has a low minute cap.
